chunks: He looked down and saw (his friend) in the midst of Hell.
ai.seo_question: What does it mean when one sees a friend in the midst of Hell in the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse (37:164) is often interpreted as describing the Prophet Muhammad's night journey or the general state of the righteous observing the depths of Hell, emphasizing the tangible reality of divine justice. It underscores the concept of 'Sawa' (the middle or center), indicating that the punishment is not peripheral but central to the experience of the damned, serving as a stark contrast to the proximity of God for the believers.
